description: The World Bank Enterprise Surveys are nationally representative firm-level surveys of top managers and owners of businesses. The portal read on 2026-09-26 states that the formal sector surveys cover more than 160 economies, aiming for 180, and address business environment topics including access to finance, corruption, infrastructure and firm performance; informal sector and micro enterprise surveys complement them. Results are published as indicators by economy and topic, and granular firm-level data are available through the Enterprise Surveys data portal. The page lists a data publication update in September 2026 (two informal sector datasets) and one in July 2026 (a survey dataset and 15 panel datasets). The infrastructure questions were not read on this page, and the access conditions of the firm-level files were not read. Caveats: survey years differ by economy. Simulation uses are estimating outage frequency and cost to firms and calibrating economic impact models of unreliable supply, once the infrastructure questions are checked. Related records: data-eagle-i-recorded-electricity-outages-us-counties is a metered outage source for comparison.
